chunks: 22 – Hishām ibn Ibrāhīm, al-ʿAbbāsī. Companion of Yūnus. He has been accused, and the accusation – according to me – is regarding his madhhab, not regarding himself.
ai.seo_question: What is the nature of the criticism against Hisham ibn Ibrahim al-Abbasi?
ai.summary: This entry from *Kitab al-Du'afa* discusses the narrator Hishām ibn Ibrāhīm al-ʿAbbāsī. The author clarifies that the criticism (taʿn) leveled against him is primarily concerning his theological school of thought (madhhab) rather than a defect in his personal character or reliability as a narrator.
